aspect: Thousands of families are in this position
description: Israel's refusal to change addresses, combined with forcible transfers back to Gaza, leaves couples with non-matching registered addresses living together in the West Bank in constant fear.
energy_note: At home, and liable to be removed from it.

aspect: The exposure is total and permanent
description: Harassment, detention, deportation, forcible transfer to Gaza, or a re-entry ban - and the risk applies at every checkpoint, every ID check and every hospital admission, for as long as the family exists.
energy_note: Every routine document check is the one that could end it.

description: The policy restricts the rights to work, to study and to seek medical care, because each of those requires presenting an ID that will show the mismatch.
energy_note: Can't work, study or be treated without showing them.

description: Because marriage typically moves the woman to the husband's area, it is overwhelmingly women who end up resident under the wrong registered address - which is why Gisha found most victims of the transfer procedure are women.
energy_note: The one who moved is the one who is illegal.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the procedure built to refuse
description: A Freedom of Information response revealed that the 'Procedure for handling applications by Gaza Strip residents for settlement in the Judea and Samaria Area', in place since 2009, is designed for rejecting applications rather than accepting them. Gisha titled its report 'A procedure so special it applies to no one'.
energy_note: A form whose function is the refusal.
